result.summary: The page is largely well-designed with clear hierarchy and good visual structure. A few minor issues were found, primarily around content truncation in the horizontal carousel and minor styling/contrast considerations.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with its name truncated. While this is a common carousel affordance, the truncation happens mid-word without a clear visual cue that more content is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient mask on the right edge of the carousel or a scroll indicator to signal that more items are available horizontally.

issues.description: The gray secondary text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') uses a light gray that may have insufficient contrast against the white background for users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Verify the gray text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1) and darken it slightly if needed.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' which contains a spelling error ('Restarants' should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
